raw.title: 2026 07 25 core 38 event dispatcher wiring
raw.body:
- **feat(core): implement dependency graph and cycle validation**
- **Update changelog for core-37-dependency-graph-design**
- **feat(events): add 9 PSR-14 lifecycle event DTOs (core-38)**
- **feat(events): SimpleEventDispatcher + NullEventDispatcher (PSR-14)**
- **feat(events): LedgerAppendingListener bridges bus -> EventLedger**
- **feat(executor): WorkflowExecutor dispatches PSR-14 lifecycle events**
- **feat(engine): Engine + StepExecutionWorker dispatch async lifecycle events**
- **feat(executor): StepOutcomeHandler dispatches StepRetried + terminal Run events**
- **feat(executor): CorrelationResumer dispatches CorrelationResumed; StepExecutor accepts dispatcher**
- **feat(laravel): bind EventDispatcherInterface -> SimpleEventDispatcher; auto-wire LedgerAppendingListener**
- **feat(laravel): IlluminatePsrEventDispatcher opt-in adapter**
- **docs(changelog): PSR-14 event dispatcher wiring landed**
- **style: pint format**
- **build(ship): core-38-event-dispatcher-wiring**
